applicability: First-sample capture counters, slot packing, relative clock/rate intervals and scheduling latency; not driver IO

equations.relative_rate: (delta_samples*1e9/delta_reference_ns / nominal_rate - 1)*1e6; endpoint interval uses elapsed +/- resolution
equations.residual: abs(delta_reference_ns - delta_samples*1e9/nominal_rate) +/- resolution, lower clipped at 0
equations.alignment: Spread of equal sample-index timestamps +/- resolution, converted to samples
equations.latency: Delivery minus first-sample capture timestamp +/- resolution on the same unverified reference

assumptions: Shared explicitly unverified reference timescale, integer relative ns/counters, no wrap adapter
Conservative interval entirely inside limit required; crossing is INCONCLUSIVE
PDM integer rate equality is metadata, not filtering/noise evidence
excluded: Physical capture/driver IO and analog group delay
Absolute calibrated oscillator accuracy or aperture jitter
ADC ENOB, PDM decimator noise/filter response

numerical_policy.decision: Exact rational interval comparisons before display rounding
